why: Declare Blockers phase: I have no creatures to block with. Pass to allow combat damage to resolve. Opponent's Rumbling Baloth (11/11, likely pumped with Giant Growth + Titanic Growth during their main phase) will deal 11 damage. Accept the damage, move to combat end, then my turn where I assess remaining options with Lightning Bolt + Shock + Brute Force in hand at 7 life remaining.
